pull-fatigue-stranded-on-puller-ttl-deat.actual: When the puller dies from `ticksToLive === 1` on the same tick a pull resolves and the puller is iterated before the pulled creep, vanilla strands the move's fatigue on the pulled creep instead of letting it die with the puller. `_add-fatigue.js:24-26` walks `_pulled` from inside per-creep `creeps/tick.js`; the puller's tick runs `movement.execute` then the lifetime check that calls `_die` and `delete roomObjects[object._id]`. The pulled creep's later `movement.execute` (`movement.js:248-251`) cannot follow `_pulled` to the now-deleted puller, so the chain walk stops and the move's body-weight fatigue lands on the pulled creep — visibly stuck if the pulled creep has no MOVE parts to clear it. Vanilla itself produces the intended outcome (fatigue=0) when the pulled creep is iterated first, so this is an order-dependent quirk rather than a designed contract.
pull-fatigue-stranded-on-puller-ttl-deat.expected: The move's fatigue is buried with the dying puller; the pulled creep ends the tick at fatigue 0 regardless of placement / iteration order. xxscreeps achieves this by routing pull-aware fatigue during a unified move-intent pass (`packages/xxscreeps/mods/creep/processor.ts:221-227`) before any per-object tick processor calls `buryCreep`.

construction-site-array-prototype-pollut.actual: Stable vanilla iterates room-edge border-tile arrays with inherited enumerable Array.prototype keys, so an enumerable user-code Array.prototype property makes otherwise-valid edge-adjacent construction sites fail validation with ERR_INVALID_TARGET.
construction-site-array-prototype-pollut.expected: Enumerable user-code additions to Array.prototype do not affect Room.createConstructionSite or RoomPosition.createConstructionSite validation near room edges.

corner-exit-tiles-auto-transition.actual: Stable vanilla auto-transitions creeps placed directly on room corner exit tiles; observed (0,0) in W1N1 moved to W2N1.
corner-exit-tiles-auto-transition.expected: Creeps on room corner tiles (0,0), (0,49), (49,0), or (49,49) remain in the same room and position on the next tick.

renew-creep-energy-structures-option-mis.actual: Stable vanilla StructureSpawn.renewCreep ignores a second options argument: non-object options are accepted, and options.energyStructures does not restrict or filter renewal energy sources.
renew-creep-energy-structures-option-mis.expected: renewCreep validates the options argument and uses options.energyStructures as the only eligible owned active spawn/extension energy source set.

legacy-path-cost-callback-false-ignored.actual: Stable vanilla Room.findPath treats a costCallback return value of false as if no room-blocking matrix was returned, so it still returns a path.
legacy-path-cost-callback-false-ignored.expected: Room.findPath treats costCallback returning false as blocking the room and returns an empty path.

attack-notify-getter-api-missing.actual: Stable vanilla exposes notifyWhenAttacked but not the notifiesWhenAttacked getter API, and spawnCreep notifyWhenAttacked initial-state checks cannot be observed.
attack-notify-getter-api-missing.expected: notifiesWhenAttacked returns the current attack-notification state and failure codes, and spawnCreep can seed the initial state.

effects-empty-array-missing.actual: Stable vanilla omits the effects property on RoomObjects that have no active effects.
effects-empty-array-missing.expected: Every RoomObject exposes effects as an array, with no active effects represented as [].

eventlog-build-energy-spent-missing.actual: Stable vanilla EVENT_BUILD entries omit data.energySpent.
eventlog-build-energy-spent-missing.expected: EVENT_BUILD data includes energySpent equal to the energy spent by the build action.

eventlog-structure-destroy-intent-missin.actual: Stable vanilla Structure.destroy() removes the structure but does not emit EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROYED for the owner-initiated intent path.
eventlog-structure-destroy-intent-missin.expected: Owner-initiated Structure.destroy() emits EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROYED with data.type equal to the destroyed structureType.

power-creep-long-name-and-ttl-pr-behavio.actual: Stable vanilla does not preserve 100-character power creep names on create/rename and exposes a non-undefined ticksToLive while unspawned or after death.
power-creep-long-name-and-ttl-pr-behavio.expected: Power creeps preserve 100-character names exactly and expose ticksToLive as undefined whenever unspawned.

market-history-empty-array-missing.actual: Stable vanilla Game.market.getHistory returns an empty object for invalid resources and valid resources with no history.
market-history-empty-array-missing.expected: Game.market.getHistory returns an empty array for invalid resources and valid resources with no history.

roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.actual: Stable vanilla RoomPosition.findClosestByPath does not use opts.range as the goal range.
roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.expected: RoomPosition.findClosestByPath uses opts.range as the goal range when deciding reachability.

movecache-fatigue-visualization-recomput.actual: Stable vanilla calls the supplied costCallback while returning ERR_TIRED for a fatigued moveTo call with a reusable cached path and visualizePathStyle.
movecache-fatigue-visualization-recomput.expected: A fatigued moveTo call with a valid reusable path and visualizePathStyle returns ERR_TIRED without recomputing a path.

moveto-all-routes-blocked-walks-into-cre.actual: Stable vanilla creep.moveTo with ignoreCreeps:false returns OK and walks the creep one tile toward the goal even when every walkable tile within range of the target is occupied by a stationary creep (screeps/engine#63).
moveto-all-routes-blocked-walks-into-cre.expected: creep.moveTo with ignoreCreeps:false returns ERR_NO_PATH when every viable route is blocked by a stationary creep.
